title: Math
summary: The mathematics of change and of strategy.

children.title: Calculus
children.summary: The mathematics of continuous change, from limits and derivatives to integrals.

children.title: Limits
children.summary: The foundational idea of approaching a value, underpinning both derivatives and integrals.

children.title: Derivatives
children.summary: Instantaneous rates of change and the slope of a curve at a point.

children.title: Integrals
children.summary: Accumulation and area under a curve — the inverse of differentiation.

children.title: Game Theory
children.summary: The study of strategic decision-making among rational agents.

children.title: Nash Equilibrium
children.summary: A strategy profile where no player can gain by unilaterally changing their own strategy.

children.title: Dominant Strategies
children.summary: Strategies that yield a better outcome for a player regardless of what the others do.

children.title: Prisoner's Dilemma
children.summary: The classic game showing why two rational agents may fail to cooperate even when it serves them both.

children.title: The Z-Transform
children.summary: The z-transform as a landscape over the complex plane, with a 3D viewer: poles, zeros, the region of convergence and the frequency response.

children.title: Points of the z-Plane
children.summary: What z to the power −n does to a sample: a spiral that scales and turns.

children.title: The Surface |X(z)|
children.summary: Poles and zeros, and how they shape the whole landscape.

children.title: The Region of Convergence
children.summary: Rings where the sum converges, and two signals that share one formula.

children.title: The Unit Circle and Frequency Response
children.summary: The surface sliced along |z| = 1, read with a ruler.

children.title: Pole Positions and the Time Signal
children.summary: Pole radius sets the decay, pole angle the oscillation.

children.title: Properties as Geometry
children.summary: Delay, scaling, modulation, reversal and convolution as moves of the plane.

children.title: Inverting the Transform
children.summary: Partial fractions and the contour integral round a circle in the ROC.

children.title: A Gallery of Signals
children.summary: Every signal in the viewer, from its samples to its stability.
